value: Parent Resources & Forms — Little Seeds & Peter Pan Schools
Everything you need, all in one place
Download enrollment forms, health records, and consent documents for all three campuses.
Please download, complete, and return the following forms before your child's first day.
Child's personal rights as required by California state licensing.
Medical report completed by your child's doctor prior to enrollment.
Parent-completed health history for your child before admission.
Consent form for administration of medications at the center.
Summary of rights for parents and guardians under California law.
Emergency contacts, authorized pick-up persons, and identification details.
LIC 627 — Consent for Emergency Medical Treatment
Authorization for emergency medical care when parents cannot be reached.
Integrated Pest Management plan as required by California state regulations.
If you have questions about which forms to complete or need assistance, contact us.
